description: The control plane page. Browser navigation takes only a path joined to the chosen PlanePin. Local SSH key commands require the committed main-frame origin to match that pin, HTTPS except loopback, and native destination approval before a native file picker. The remote page receives only an opaque signer id, public identity, and public SSH-agent replies. No node commands, file paths, private keys, passphrases, generic filesystem/dialog grants, or unlock-form authority. The wildcard permits OAuth redirects; redirect pages cannot use the signer.
